newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kerry joins 228 mln yuan water venture.
newsitem.headline: Kerry joins 228 mln yuan water venture.

text.p: Kerry Properties Ltd said on Monday it has signed a 228 million yuan contract with Kuok Brothers Sdn Bhd and Benxi Water Supply Co Ltd to form a joint venture company called Kerry Benxi Water Resources Corp.

Kerry Properties said the water resources joint venture is 70 percent owned by Kerry-Chemquest Benxi Water Co Ltd and 30 percent by Benxi Water Supply. Kerry-Chemquest is equally owned by Kerry Properties and a subsidiary of Kuok Brothers.

"This is Kerry Properties Ltd's first water resources project in China and we are confident that it will provide steady long-term recurring earnings for the group in the future," Ang Keng Lam, joint managing director of Kerry Properties, said in a statement.
The joint venture will construct a dam to supply water to Beitai Steel Mill in Benxi city and the surrounding residential area in China's northeastern province of Liaoning, it said.

Upon completion, the project should have the capacity to store 74 million cubic metres of water and supply more than 60 million cubic metres of water and 2.7 million kilowatt hours of electricity per year, the statement said.
